visual_notes: A social media post discussing Google's strategy of focusing on smaller, cheaper, and faster models to maintain efficiency at scale, contrasting their position with other AI companies.
important_information: Google is prioritizing smaller, cheaper, and faster models.
Efficiency is critical for Google due to the scale of Gemini in search.
Google's market position allows for a long-term strategic approach compared to competitors.
ocr_text: google is clearly focusing on smaller, cheaper, faster models. they're also in a very different position from everyone else and don't need AI to survive as a company, so they can afford to play a much longer game. gemini is already in basically every search, so efficiency matters at huge scale.
